entities.name: Replay external effects through affine continuations
entities.summary: Drive strict first-order observation scripts through the reference interpreter and independent bytecode VM while retaining opaque one-shot continuation custody and exact differential request traces.

acceptance: Strict bounded observation scripts drive multiple external requests in order
Reference and compiled continuations remain opaque process-local and one-shot
Every request, provided observation, applied observation, and final result remains explicit
Wrong-type, thunk-valued, forged, foreign, and duplicate resume attempts reject visibly
Conclusive reference and compiled effect-run observations agree as exact canonical bytes
Existing first-suspension kernel-run observations remain byte-identical

relations.summary: The reference machine supplies the accepted semantic oracle and existing one-shot external token.
The independent VM must retain and resume its own continuation without calling the reference machine.
Adds a bounded request/observation interpretation journey over the kernel's existing affine effect semantics.
